description: Find restaurants and other food establishments by name and return each one's latest health inspection: in New York City the posted letter grade (A, B, C or pending) and the score in points, in Chicago Pass, Pass w/ Conditions or Fail, in Austin the score out of 100, in Boston the pass/fail result and open violations. Without a city or ZIP it searches all four cities. Returns the id for restaurant_inspection_history.

address.description: Street words to narrow a chain, e.g. "Houston" or "350 5th Ave".

city.description: New York City (or Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island), Chicago, Austin or Boston (or a Boston neighborhood).

limit.description: How many establishments to return. Default 10.

name.description: Restaurant name or part of it, e.g. "Katz's Delicatessen" or "Au Cheval".

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code in a covered city.

name: restaurant_inspection_search
title: Restaurant health inspection lookup
